# Needle

Type: Material | Internal ID: Needle | Source: Deathsquito | Usage: Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Needle is a crafting material dropped from Deathsquitoes in the Plains biome. It can also be found in chests in Fuling Villages and Fuling Ruins.

### Crafting

• Needle arrow
• Porcupine
